metaDescription: Professional, insured house removals, man and van, and packing in Tamworth. Modern Luton vans, DBS-checked movers, and transparent fixed pricing.
intro: Jimmys Removals provides reliable, insured house removals, furniture assembly, and packing across Tamworth and its 13 surrounding districts. Steeped in rich Mercian history, Tamworth features riverside residences, established estates in Belgrave and Amington, and modern family developments near Ventura Retail Park and the A5 corridor. Our experienced moving team ensures your home transition proceeds smoothly with clean 3.5-tonne Luton vans, careful loading, and guaranteed fixed pricing. We comprehensively cover all 13 local districts across Tamworth including Amington, Bolehall, Dosthill, Glascote, Hopwas, Kettlebrook, Mile Oak, Stonydelph, Two Gates, Wilnecote, Belgrave, Coton Green, and Tamworth Town centre. From protecting delicate glassware to assembling large flat-pack wardrobes, our directly employed porters handle every detail of your moving day with utmost professionalism and care.
